head_commit.message:
Keep agent command center rows stable across progress updates (#52946)

## Why

Progress updates change task timestamps, causing recency-based sorting to move rows within the same status group on refresh.

## What changed

Retain each task's relative order while it remains in the same status group. Append new tasks and tasks that change groups after existing rows in their destination group. Forget the order of removed tasks so rediscovered tasks behave like new arrivals.

Search and status filters preserve the retained order, and pinned tasks continue to use their explicit ordering.

## Testing

Add regression tests and a snapshot covering progress refreshes, selection stability, arrivals, status transitions (including changes caused by descendants), removal and rediscovery, filters, and pins.

head_commit.message:
Retain client-marked tool outputs across compaction (#52937)

## Why

Client-supplied tool outputs can carry task instructions. Even when marked with `retain: true`, these instructions could be trimmed before compaction and disappear from the compacted history.

## What changed

Add the disabled-by-default `retain_client_tool_outputs` feature to honor retention for explicitly marked, named `function_call_output` items without a `call_id`.

- Preserve eligible outputs in remote compaction v2 and when starting a new context window, keeping their original role.
- Stop emergency tool-output trimming at a retained output.
- Share the existing 64,000-token retention budget, keeping outputs whole and dropping an oversized output and older items rather than partially truncating it.
- Place initial context before retained standalone outputs and account for their images in retained-image counts.

## Testing

Add a scenario covering enabled and disabled retention, emergency trimming, oversized-output handling, and preservation of the latest instruction after compaction and cold resume. Verify that retention annotations stay out of model requests.

GitOrigin-RevId: 449179670e4d2be2623928700738758e43b5dc1a

head_commit.message:
Retain client-marked tool outputs across compaction

## Why

Client-supplied tool outputs can carry task instructions. Even when marked with `retain: true`, these instructions could be trimmed before compaction and disappear from the compacted history.

## What changed

Add the disabled-by-default `retain_client_tool_outputs` feature to honor retention for explicitly marked, named `function_call_output` items without a `call_id`.

- Preserve eligible outputs in remote compaction v2 and when starting a new context window, keeping their original role.
- Stop emergency tool-output trimming at a retained output.
- Share the existing 64,000-token retention budget, keeping outputs whole and dropping an oversized output and older items rather than partially truncating it.
- Place initial context before retained standalone outputs and account for their images in retained-image counts.

## Testing

Add a scenario covering enabled and disabled retention, emergency trimming, oversized-output handling, and preservation of the latest instruction after compaction and cold resume. Verify that retention annotations stay out of model requests.
